node_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Agency
node_kinds.description: A U.S. federal agency or sub-agency from the FedRAMP Marketplace that authorizes, reuses, or is otherwise associated with cloud offerings.

markdown.content: Federal agencies and sub-agencies listed in the FedRAMP Marketplace. Parent agencies may contain sub-agencies via `FedRAMP_Contains`. Agencies authorize or reuse cloud products for government use.

node_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Assessor
node_kinds.description: A FedRAMP-accredited Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) that assesses cloud products.

markdown.content: Accredited 3PAOs that perform independent assessments of FedRAMP cloud offerings. Connected to products through `FedRAMP_Assesses`.

node_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Product
node_kinds.description: A cloud service offering (CSO) listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace, including authorization status and impact level.

markdown.content: FedRAMP cloud service offerings. Products are provided by CSPs, assessed by 3PAOs, authorized or reused by agencies, and may leverage other products.

node_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Provider
node_kinds.description: A Cloud Service Provider (CSP) that offers one or more FedRAMP Marketplace products.

markdown.content: Cloud Service Providers that publish offerings on the FedRAMP Marketplace. Linked to products through `FedRAMP_Provides`.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: A parent agency contains a sub-agency.

markdown.content: Represents the organizational hierarchy between a parent agency and one of its sub-agencies.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Authorizes
relationship_kinds.description: An agency authorizes a FedRAMP product for use.

markdown.content: The agency is an authorizing official (or equivalent) for the product on the FedRAMP Marketplace.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Reuses
relationship_kinds.description: An agency reuses another agency's authorization for a FedRAMP product.

markdown.content: The agency relies on an existing FedRAMP authorization rather than issuing its own.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_InProcess
relationship_kinds.description: An agency has a product authorization currently in process.

markdown.content: The agency is actively working through authorization for the product, but it is not yet complete.
The assessor is the independent third-party assessment organization for the product.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Provides
relationship_kinds.description: A CSP provides a FedRAMP product.

markdown.content: The cloud service provider owns or operates the marketplace product offering.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_Leverages
relationship_kinds.description: A product leverages another FedRAMP product or underlying system.

markdown.content: The offering depends on another FedRAMP-authorized product as part of its authorization boundary or inheritance.

relationship_kinds.name: FedRAMP_PartnersWith
relationship_kinds.description: A product partners with an agency for authorization.

markdown.content: The product lists a partnering agency on the FedRAMP Marketplace.
